subject: Reconciled remediation package and patch-window schedule for SIG CVE follow-up
messages:
From: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@acme.io>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-security-team@acme.io
Date: 2027-04-20T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire - evidence for CVE remediation

Jonas / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick answers in the SIG sheet. We have a final evidence ask from our compliance team before we can close the questionnaire: for the set of critical/high CVEs you listed (CVE-2027-1351, CVE-2027-1337, CVE-2026-9988) we need a reconciled remediation package that includes:

- Exact patch windows (UTC) and deployment runbooks used
- Confirmation of whether fixes were upstream or backported, and the kernel/vendor patch versions
- Evidence that the fixes were applied (screenshots or agent logs) and a short regression test summary
- Any compensating controls applied while the patch was pending

Can you provide a single package that ties the CVE IDs to artifacts? Our window for SIG closure is this week; ideally within 72 hours. If you need an extended window, flag it and explain why.

Appreciate it — we can redact anything that looks internal if needed.

Best,
Alice
Alice Bennett
Security Engineer, Acme Inc

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire - evidence for CVE remediation

Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level plan below; I'll own delivery and Marissa will produce the artifact bundle.

Planned deliverables (timeline in UTC):
- T+24h: Manifest mapping each CVE to commit/patch IDs and targeted instances (attachment: patch_manifest.csv)
- T+48h: Agent logs + screenshots for applied patches; short regression checklist per CVE
- T+72h: Consolidated PDF (cve_postmortem_20270422.pdf) with backport notes and compensating controls documented

Notes / potential exception: one of the affected third-party libs (vendor X) has a delayed upstream release; if the backport requires a kernel rebuild we may need a 5-day extended window for that CVE. We'll call this out explicitly and provide compensating access control and monitoring in the interim.

Attachments referenced: patch_manifest.csv (draft). We'll upload the full bundle to a shared drive and link the Jira SEC ticket for traceability.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>, Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@acme.io>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire - evidence for CVE remediation

Alice, Jonas — attaching interim artifacts and short notes. See below summary and files attached in this message: kernel_backport_notes.txt, regression_screenshots.zip (3 PNGs), and an exported agent log snippet for affected instances.

Summary (interim):
- CVE-2027-1351: Patch applied by rolling deploy on 2027-04-20 23:00 UTC to all prod clusters. Upstream patch (v1.4.2) available; we applied upstream on primary and backported to 1.3.x for legacy hosts. Evidence: agent log lines 1200-1234 (attached), screenshots of successful health checks in regression_screenshots.zip.
- CVE-2027-1337: Hotfix from vendor X not yet in stable; we applied vendor-supplied hotpatch on 2027-04-21 02:15 UTC to container runtime. Mitigations: restricted container image serve policy + temporary network ACL to block exploit vectors (compensating control).
- CVE-2026-9988: Remediated at 2027-04-20 21:30 UTC via package update (libdelta v2.9.1). Regression tests (smoke + auth flows) passed: see regression checklist included.

Two operational caveats:
1) The vendor X hotfix required kernel module rebuild on a subset of older hosts; that subset received a staggered patch (scheduled next maintenance window 2027-04-25) — we'll include the full backport notes.
2) Screenshots are sanitized for internal IPs per our redaction policy. If Acme needs raw logs we can provide an auditor view with redactions or a short scoped access window.

Forwarding the interim bundle to the Drive link and creating SEC-4821 to track closure.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: kernel_backport_notes.txt (text), regression_screenshots.zip (archive), patch_manifest.csv (updated)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Bennett <alice.bennett@acme.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, acme-security-team@acme.io
Date: 2027-04-22T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire - evidence for CVE remediation (final package)

Alice / Acme team — delivering the finalized remediation package and short SLA note below. Full bundle uploaded here: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/1a2b3cVulnReconcile (read-only link). Jira link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/SEC-4821.

Package contents included in PDF: cve_postmortem_20270422.pdf (mapping table, timeline, regression summary), patch_manifest.csv (master mapping), kernel_backport_notes.txt, regression_screenshots.zip, and a short post-deploy monitoring log.

SLA note: all CVEs were remediated or mitigated within the planned windows except for the vendor-X backport subset; we requested a temporary extension for that subset due to the vendor release cadence and documented compensating controls (network ACL, elevated monitoring). We acknowledge this may require a formal exception in the SIG response — happy to provide an internal change ticket and evidence of monitoring (sampling dashboards) if needed.

If this package satisfies the evidence requirements, please confirm and we'll close the SEC ticket and the SIG item. If you need additional raw logs or a signed attestation from our SOC owner, let me know and Marissa will prepare the signature page.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
Attachments: cve_postmortem_20270422.pdf (final), patch_manifest.csv (final)
